findings.title: The feature-flagged table visualization always renders an empty table
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch passes `columns={[]}` and a `tableData` with empty `data`, `fields`, and `units` instead of the current `result`. Consequently, dashboard table widgets show no columns or rows for organizations using the new visualization. Pass the actual result data and metadata, along with the appropriate columns.

findings.title: PR comment generation calls helpers that the workflow does not define
findings.body: `get_comment_body` runs on a `GitHubPRCommentWorkflow` and calls `self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` (and `self.get_environment_info`). Those helpers were added to `CommitContextIntegration`, not the PR workflow class, so they are not available on this `self`; generating a comment raises `AttributeError` instead of returning the comment body. The GitLab workflow has the same issue. Move the helpers onto the workflow or call them through its integration.

findings.title: Attribute-key query cache key omits the organization
findings.body: This query key contains the filters but not the organization slug, even though the query function fetches keys from an organization-specific endpoint. When switching organizations with the same filters (especially when all projects are selected), the query client can reuse the previous organization's cached attribute keys, showing incorrect or organization-specific metadata. Include the organization slug in the query key.

findings.title: Age and timestamp validation accepts invalid field combinations and values
findings.body: Both temporal fields are optional, so a report with neither `age` nor `timestamp` is accepted. The cross-field validators also use truthiness, allowing both fields to be present when both are zero, and `age` has no non-negative constraint. These malformed reports receive a successful response and increment the received-report metric; require exactly one temporal field by checking presence and validate age as non-negative.
